name: Exponential
summary: Double the wait after every failure, up to a cap. Load on a struggling service falls geometrically, but every client still comes back at the same instant.

params.name: baseMs
params.description: The first delay, doubled on each subsequent attempt.

params.name: capMs
params.description: No delay exceeds this, however many attempts have failed.

params.name: maxAttempts
params.description: Give up after this many attempts.

notes: Backing off exponentially converts a continuous herd into a periodic one. It does not disperse it. Ship exponential-full-jitter instead unless you need a delay sequence reproducible without a random source.
